nom: Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Hybrid Broad Spectrum SPF 50

avis.texte: It is perfect for my skin. Does not leave a milky look on the skin.
Never had an issue with the brand, but this product specifically gave me a white cast. One thing that is helping to finish it, is to moisturize with shea butter then adding the sunscreen.

I usually love these products but i just purchased this one for the first time and after using it for several days in a row now it does leave a bit of a white cast on my skin. Im not sure if its because its a hybrid and mixed with mineral lotion too. But i do like that its spf 50 and it seems to be working.
Makes my skin look heathy and toned. I don't get a white cast and it makes my skin feel smooth and not tacky🙏 very happy!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again! Great product!!!!
avis.texte: This product is great and the price is right! I would recommend this product and definitely will purchase it again. My sister gave me a tube as a gift and I've been using it since then.

avis.titre: Not for the dry skin girlies
avis.texte: I was recommended this by an employee that said it will not leave a white cast and it's good for dry skin. Neither was true. You have to rub it in so much to get rid of the white cast and it absolutely dried my face out bad. Would not recommend.
I have been seeing this sunscreen around social media and decided to give it a try...WOW, so glad I did, it is a very good product. No white residue after applying it, great for melanin skin people.
This is one of the best sunscreens that I've used in a long time. I really appreciate that's it's in a gel formula.

avis.titre: Please put "lavender scented" on the bottle.
avis.texte: Bought this after enjoying the other Black Girl Sunscreen and wanting to try a hybrid. I was very disappointed using this and realizing it has a STRONG lavender odor and fragrance isnt mentioned on the front. I am breaking out and want a refund.

I used to use the Black Girl Sunscreen Kids Version but I realized I began to have some Peeling when I used it with my other skin care products. So I decided to switch to the Hybrid. It leaves a horrible white cast. And it causes my skin to have to some tiny bumps on my cheeks. I also noticed I was having more breakouts than normal. The texture is pretty good, but it will dry down Matte, & leave your skin oily as well. And it leaves your eyes with a stinging sensation.

I love sunscreen for Black Girls! I keep at least two bottles on hand. I use the OG 30 spf, the matte spf, and the lipgloss. I do find the taste of the lipgloss to be a bit bitter but it does its job. I have an interracial family and we all use it.
Love the texture and smell of this sunscreen. Amazing, best I have ever used.

I absolutely love this product! It is the last item i use in my daily skin routine die the morning! The ONLY time ive had a white cast on my brown skin is when i didnt allow the other products to dry prior to application. My esthetician advised me start usng sunscreen bc of my uneven skin tone.. I've noticed a huge differnce and i ALWAYS wear my big sunglasses to protect my eyes from dark spots

avis.titre: Overhyped Sunscreen That Broke Me Out
avis.texte: I didn't like that this sunscreen still had a scent even though it's labeled unscented. While it doesn't leave a white cast (which is a plus), the fragrance caused a mild breakout. It feels overhyped and heavily marketed to Black women when there are better options out there.
i use mineral sunscreens because i have sensitive skin. i expect to have a white cast but the smell is too much. it needs to be fragrance free.

The product is similar to the other blackgirl sunscreen but not exactly. This sunscreen leaves a white cast that you have to kee rubbing it into your skin, the consistency is loose not solid like how the other one is, and with one little squeeze the lotion is all over the place
I don't wear makeup, so it's a little messy for me. It is very light and I could see it working well for makeup users.

Clears my skin, and dark spots every time. Also, don't put more than a dime sized amount in! A little of this product goes a long way, it'll feel greasy if you put more than needed, and will be harder to rub on.

avis.titre: Don't buy hybrid , buy the original!!
avis.texte: The hybrid sunscreen leaves a white cast, as for the original one it does not.
I loveeeee this sunscreen. Ive tried a few and had differen issues between breakouts, not mixing well with other products and longevitity. This one has been the best by far

Honestly, the BEST sunscreen containing zinc I have ever had! Read the reviews online and wasn't disappointed with the product! Found my new longterm daily sunscreen and I think your business and product is INCREDIBLE

It broke me out. I have very sensitive skin. I've been looking for a sunscreen that would agre with my skin, but this didn't. I use it on my daughter now during her track meets to shield from the sun but as for me and my sensitive skin… it's a no. So far it's agreed with my daughter's skin. I use it on her face, neck, arms and legs.
I have the SPF 50 hybrid... it leaves a white cast. this is my first time experiencing this in the 5 years of using only this sunscreen. Maybe its a high spf idk but. . i hatee itt

I have sensitive facial skin and this does not break me out. There is not white cast for me. I do notice a little in the beginning, but as I continue to massage into my skin it goes away like poof. I have tried so many sunscreens and this by far is better for my melanin skin. I have been using for a few years and I am satisfied. It is moisturizing and I use under my makeup. Not everyone's skin is the same, results will vary.
It does its job as a SPF, however if you sweat its irritates and burns your eyes!
Great product for sun protection without the white caste left by most sunscreens. It also moisturizes the skin which is a great benefit.
This product is so oily. Its starts off matte and afrer 5 minutes literally it gets sooo oily. Then you feel the pimples forming. I wanted to love it but no, do not purchase it.

I love this sunscreen and that there is a hybrid chemical/mineral option. It goes on fairly smoothly and is a little greasy but doesnt have that weird sort of chalky mineral sunscreen feel. Reviews I've read do point out a white cast on darker skin tones. I'm white and don't notice any white cast on myself. I was a little cautious when I first opened it because of a strong lavender essential oil scent, but I've had no problems using it on my face and arms and love the smell. I've started stocking up on this I love it so much!

I added this sunscreen to my routine and when i tell you it has completely changed my skin i mean it. I wanted something cheaper than the unseen sunscreen so i tried it & now I am in tears daily because of how many pimples and scars this product has left me. If i could rate it 0 stars i would. I had pretty decent skin before this and now i can hardly stand to look in the mirror. DISGUSTING OILY PRODUCT RUINING SKIN ONE BOTTLE AT A TIME!!!
Black Girl Sunscreen does not leave a white cast. I was nervous at first because I thought it would, but it didn't.
One of my fav sunscreens ever. Goes on smoothly and no white cast. Skin feels hydrated

I recently took a trip to Italy and knowing how sensitive my skin is, I made sure I had this protection on me at all times. Making sure I did touchups when was needed and I could say I just continue to love your product.
My whole family LOVES these products! The size of the bottles are perfect! The texture is creamy and light not oily. I am very satisfied with my selections.

I use this when I am outside playing pickleball. It really works because when I have forgotten to use it, my shoulders are toast. They got burned once and I learned my lesson. I love the smell and often get compliments from others. I have not experienced any irritation with it and I have used it for years. It blends in wonderfully. And it's non greasy. People always ask me if I need to wipe my hands with a towel afterwards because I am about to play but I find that the lotion is pretty quick absorbing. Again, I don't use it on my face. I use Make it Matte on my face. Love the product! I don't think I've ever been so diligent with my sunscreen protection or committed to a brand like this until I used Black Girl Sunscreen. Highly recommended!

I am an unpaid reviewer, but these other reviews are clearly biased bc of the brand name. I've been using BGS 50 for ~2 years, & it gives me no white case, my skin feels moisturized with use, it provides great coverage, no breakouts & price is great.

avis.titre: Cool and all but not worth the hype
avis.texte: The lid doesnt function properly so Spilled sunscreen everywhere every time you open it And it leaves a white cast and im lightskin so you can imagine what it foes for those more pigmented
I've been using used this product a little over three years. It works great on my skin. It also leaves a nice glow to my face and neck.

I've been searching for a sunscreen like this for awhile. Others have been too greasy and chalky on my skin, while not offering enough protection. As someone who easily burns and is a heavy sweater in the summer time, this was exactly what I needed - light, water resistant, and smooth.

Easy to apply. Very creamy. Luxurious feeling product. Smells great First time using this brand. Heard about from my niece tried it for myself and was very pleased with the results. The price was alright. Considering the sun screen itself was over my expectations.
I love this on the body, it blends in perfectly on my skin but for the face it has a slight white-cast and can be chalky when applying over product which is why I gave it 4 Stars
Black Girl sunscreen has been good for my skin. The cream does not irritate my skin especially my face. I only use a small amount on my face and arms.
This is. To r best sunscreen that I have ever used. It is easily to apply to the face. I am in awe how amazing. This product is.
Keeps my skin protected while adding a radiant glow that will leave your skin skinning 😂

I switched to this from the lower spf one and its horrible. It smells kind of perfumey but it says fragrance free. Also, it leaves a horrible white cast and clogged my pores causing me to break out. Ive decided to just switch brands completley
I love the sunscreen especially because it's made for melanated beautiful skin tones.
Great skin protection for the body. Doesn't leave a white cast. One of my many purchases during the summer
I have oily skin so I bought it thinking it would have oil control. No, it made my face even more oily
I don't know if they changed the formula, but this product gave me a TERRIBLE white cast… I thought it was supposed to do the opposite..

This is a bit on the runny side & does poor out rather quickly. . . if change I'd thicken up just a little. Buuttttt it absorbed really well. Its Not heavy, greasy or sticky. I've used MANY other brands in the past. I Really like this sunscreen. Its honestly has helped with my eczema from all the various oils. This fact alone I'll continue with this product.
takes so long to rub in, leaves a white cast, didnt even make me glow like my other black girl sunscreen
It's fine. I've been using the products the products for years. Referred other as well. I want to make sure my skin is protected. I can get sunburned very quickly. Protection is the key.
Light texture / Smooth Finish/ Ease of application One's skin feels rejuvenated
I love this sunscreen, it leaves no residue and my skin feels great. The quality is very good.

The formula has definitely changed for the worst. In the past I would highly recommend but this new "mineral" change is horrible and caused a rash and skin burn. Also very watery. Will no longer be using or buying this product.

So, I specifically like this sunscreen for myself, but there are a few reasons I might think it wouldn't work as well for others. Pros: -Lavendar essence? Honestly that's a bonus when you work outdoors, a lot of insects don't love lavender, and I genuinely think it helps repel them a bit. For reference I worked out in the deep woods near a wetland all of last summer. I put on this sunscreen and my usual bug spray every morning and I barely got bit, it was wild. Can't say for sure if that was the reason, but hey, didn't hurt. If you like lavender, it's a bonus. -I have -very- sensitive skin. I can't put that banana boat SPF 50 sport on my face or neck without it irritating the heck out of me (sometimes my arms too). A lot of sunscreens (even ones that are supposed to be for the face!) do the same thing to me. This one? Never had that problem. I can use it on my face and body and it's SPF 50. No itchiness, no irritation, no problems. Cons: -I'm white! I don't recommend this to my friends who have darker skin than me without mentioning that a lot of folks with actual melanin notice a cast from it. This is unfortunately something I've seen about this one specifically on multiple sites. Maybe one of the other products from this line would be better? Bit of a bummer when it's supposed to be for darker skin tones. -If you don't like lavender or are allergic to it, stay away!!! I love it but not everyone does. Tl;dr it's great if you're sensitive and like lavender but it leaves a cas

This is the first sunscreen I've tried from the brand and I am BEYOND disappointed. Not only is this product super watery and messy, but it broke my arms out into itchy bumps and red hives. This will be the first and last product I buy.

I shoulf start off by disclaiming Im pasty as heck and i have extreamly sensitive skin but, generally i would recommend this to every shade of skin except maybe very dark people, which i would recommend avoiding mineral sunscreens all together becaus you cannot avoid a white cast unless its tinted. If youre dark and it leaves you looking gray and dont want to waste it just add a lil water based foundation to tint it. The only major cons are that yes, i do think the recipe has changed for the worst, also it smells like lavender for some reason dispite saying its fragrence free (it what way does lavender oil protect my skin from the sun??) and you have to rub it in so it doesnt leave a white cast. Other people who say it leaves a white cast I suspect simply aren't finessing it enough. I prefer mineral sunscreen for the fact that im less likely to be allergic to it and i like chemical because its less likely to give me acne and this has both those benefits. It leaves your skin looking a little pearlescent which i like. Its easy to use too much because of the texture however. Its generally a pretty good sunscreen for my needs as a sunscreen connoisseur.
I thought it would be a good sunscreen for my darker complexion but nope, leaves a white cast and the formula is super water. It does have a smell but it's not a bad one. Do not buy
Personal favorite I love that's is hydrating and it really protects your from the sun

avis.titre: It's odd this sunscreen is called "Black Girl Sunscreen"
avis.texte: If you have any melanin, unfortunately this isn't for you. As soon as you apply this there is an immediate WHITE cast that doesn't fade. If you are any shade of brown, please listen to the reviews and don't waste your money.

Ive been using Black Girl Sunscreen for years. Its moistuizing and most improtantly, it does not leave a cast on my skin. I was shocked to see so many negative reviews. This product is a staple in my beaityu routine!
The sun screen was good, no white residue, it was not completely fragrance free. I feel like it dispense too much at once. If the hole can be smaller, that would be great
As someone with Asian skin, finding a sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast has always been a challenge. This sunscreen is super hydrating and absorbs quickly without leaving a white cast.

I really live this sunscreen for the BODY. I don't think it's formulated fir the face. It melts into my skin without giving a white or grayish look. I have never used it on my face and suspect that's where sine of the negative reviews come from.
The Make it Hydrid SPF 50 suncreen's consistency is thin yet potent. Less is more. During application, I advise rubbing it in more to lose the white streak.
I have been use it for a few a years and doesn't irritated my skin . Glows my skin
It works just the way I like. I dont like that its so watery though. I have to be careful when opening the lid
Blends in well with my medium dark complexion! Light and long lasting.

I've always used BGS SPF 30 and I wanted to try something with a higher SPF. Please do not get this product especially on African American skin. This product left white cast all over, even when I tried to rub it all in

avis.titre: Horrible- I really wanted to love it.
avis.texte: This does not rub in skin well, leave a milky white dewey residue! Additionally, it does not play well with other products, I tried three different moisturizers and this sunscreen pills on top of all of them. I can't use this without moisturizer as I have normal to dry skin. This is useless. It pills on top of almost every moisturizer and leaves a milky dewey residue. Just a hot mess. I am truly disappointed, I wanted to love this and I wasted money, as I have to throw out a full tube of sunscreen.
I have a sun allergy and I apply this several times during the day has lessened my reaction. I also like that it's kind of moisturizing.

avis.titre: Don't buy for darker tone skin types
avis.texte: This left a horribke white cast on my face, and had the nerve to burn my face. I will never buy this product ever in life.

I'm loving this SPF 50♡. It goes on smoothly. It blends in with no white after look. It is a little runny so you have to be careful when pouring it out. I will be a regular customer ♡. Thank you Black Girl Sunsceen♡.

I never write reviews but I am really disappointed. I used to use this sunscreen faithfully years ago but stopped for a while. I am not sure if they have changed the formula but it took forever to blend in and left a white cast, which never happened before.
It does leave a white cast on your skin. I used it once and never again.

avis.titre: Not as Transparent finish as SPF 30
avis.texte: I prefer the SPF 30 since this one leaves a bit of the grayish tint that I don't like. I bought this specifically to use on vacation because I wanted better coverage and was upset that I didn't just buy my normal SPF 30. I still used it. I will probably just use this on my neck area during the spring/ summer. Not sure if the formula changed. Have bern using SPF for many years with this brand and never disappointed.

I'm a repeat buyer of the products overall. I don't have any complaints about the hybrid formula. The regular formula gives my face a little more dewy finish and shine and this is in the middle of the road in terms of finish having just a slight shine on the face and still moisturizing. It's a little more runny coming out of the bottle however I still liked the product. I think purchase depending on what you are looking for. I use the matte formula with my makeup.

I love the texture not too watery but also not too heavy for a cream. The size is perfect for travel, which is a plus and of course the finish is amazing no white cast once you have applied and it has absorbed properly. Fantastic product!
i wanted to love this. but it broke me out so bad, left a white cast, and the formula is just not it. so disappointed.
I like this sunscreen for my body, my only problem is that it's extremely runny so more comes out than needed.
This is my go to sun protection! I use it as the last step in my skincare routine in the morning and reapply as needed. Definitely worth the cost and it is effective! no white cast either , woohoo!

avis.titre: Best Sunscreen for people of color
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen. My face is not oily and it does not leave a white cast. I have sensitive skin, however, I have not experienced any breakouts from this sunscreen. Great product for people of color.

Been using for years , very light not to grease my favorite one so far
I love the way the sunscreen feels on my skin. The lack of a white cast makes it even better!
I do love black girl sunscreen because you don't have to keep trying to rub the white cream in & you can just enjoy your sun bathing.

I honestly cannot believe this comes from the brand it does because it is the only sunscreen of theirs that has not delivered on what the description says it would. I'm trying to use it the best I can but only because it is too expensive to toss out

I'm lightskin and this product still left a pretty visible white cast over my skin, and mixes poorly with my makeup so NO THANK YOUU
The hybrid is a great mix or both. I does not have a white cast, which is the best thing ever. Great product.

avis.titre: Review After Using for a Year
avis.texte: So I started using this June 2023 and I can honestly say I love it. I use it everyday after I do my morning skincare on my face and I can definitely tell the difference in my face since last year. It doesn't leave a whitecast if you don't use too much and if you rub it in good. Its very liquidy so a little goes a long way I use a lil less than a dime size. BUY IT! Try it for yourself before you decide not to because of the reviews. This the only sunscreen I use on my face and it doesn't break me out it honestly helped with my breakouts.
I forget about this sunscreen as soon as it's on because it's not greasy. And it naturally smells like lavender from the lavender oil not strongly just a really nice slight bit
This is maybe the best sunscreen I've ever used! It doesn't burn my eyes - which is so important to me! It lasts a good long time!
This spf 50 works great. I use retinol and a higher spf is recommended. But the best part is no white cast. I'm very happy with the products from BGS.

I wrote a glowing, thorough review of this Black Girl Sunscreen Make It Hybrid 50 SPF recently but it has not been posted on Ulta for some reason. This product is not only affordable, but it is better for you than a lot of other products on the market right now, AND you can use it on both face and body. You need to pour it out slowly and a little goes a long way. Start with a small amount and dab around first- allow it to absorb into your skin before going outside. It goes on like a watery lotion, and dries clear, and makes my skin look great.

I put this on thinking it would be better than the original since it has spf 50. I bought this and immediately put it on in the car after and it turned my skin white. I struggled to get this off before I went back into ulta. It still didnt come off. Fortunately, they let me return it.
COME ON SMOOTH ..NO WHITE RESIDUE..LOVE IT ..WILL CONTINUE TO BUY..FINALLY FOUND A SUNSCREEN I LIKE..

I don't have much experience with different sunscreens. This is the second sunscreen I've ever tried. I like that when I put it on I don't have to worry about seeing a white cast unlike the last sunscreen I had. It melts well and the smell isn't something that's overbearing. It gets the job done.
Unlike advertise, it does leave a thick white cast, even after going in the water. I tested it by applying a thinner coat, and I still had the visible white residue. I was kind of disappointed.

Leaves a purpley-blue cast! I noticed the cast upon application but I assumed the product needed time to settle and the cast would disappear...... nope!! Hours later, I was out running errands. I was sooooo embarassed when I walked past a mirror.
Goes on without leaving a white residue. I use it for protection while playing golf in Florida in temperatures in the 90s. It works!

I bought this sunscreen for the first time to take on my beach vacation and I absolutely loved it! It made me glow and I tanned beautifully without the dry skin/peeling after effects I usually have with other sunscreens.
